spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the spec's own ::column clause in §3.1.6 (tabpanel goes to the ::column's originating element) by composing columns fragmentation, ::column::scroll-marker, and the tabs mode keyword with a fallback base declaration.

interactive.rationale: The height slider re-fragments the list live (marker count and measured page count change), mode buttons re-declare the property, markers navigate pages, and the geometry readout updates on every action.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises pages of tabs with zero wrapper markup driven by ::column; the page is one flat list plus CSS.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unsupported-::column, rejected-mode-keyword, and re-fragmentation states, and honestly documents that counters do not increment on ::column in the build browser; RTL and nested-scroller fragmentation behaviour are not exercised.

references.rationale: Chromestatus entry, the modes spec section, and the v135 ::column feature demo.

conformance.rationale: Relies on the feature suite for the shared parse contracts; the composition itself is validated by runtime geometry (page count from scrollWidth) rather than an unmeasurable role claim.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP run on Chromium 141: initial fragmentation measured 6 pages at 16rem, slider to 10rem re-fragmented to 12 pages and back to fewer at 26rem, mode switch and marker row verified, page scroll driven, zero console errors, desktop + 360px screenshots read; markers per generated ::column confirmed visually.

telemetry_health.rationale: refragmentation-measured asserts with before/after page counts on every slider move; separate asserts for applied vs rejected mode branches and the no-::column-support branch.

design_system.rationale: Entries are paper cards on a stone scroller, all colours variables, buttons flip background+color, dots invert via :target-current.

accessibility.rationale: Range input has a visible descriptive label wired with aria-describedby to the live geometry readout, mode buttons expose aria-pressed, the scroller is labelled, markers are keyboard-focusable with visible focus, and the readout is aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The paginated scroller is itself the overflow container so the page keeps scrollWidth 360 under mobile emulation; slider and buttons are 44px; fragmentation works identically at both widths (page width tracks the container).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Drive slide/page state from scroll position with scroll-snap and CSS state selectors instead of scripted observers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages are snap targets via ::column { scroll-snap-align: start } and the active dot is pure :target-current; the only script is measurement and honest capability reporting.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider accessible label live output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Every interactive control needs an accessible name, and changing state should surface through text or a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The slider's label contains its purpose and current value, and results are announced through the aria-live geometry readout that aria-describedby points at.

openQuestions.title: Number the ::column markers once counter-increment works on ::column
openQuestions.detail: On the build browser, counter(pagenum) inside ::column::scroll-marker always renders 0 (counter-increment does not apply to ::column yet), so the markers ship as square glyphs and the page says why. When a Chromium build increments counters on ::column, switch content to 'Page ' counter(pagenum) for labelled tabs and update the honest-limitation paragraph.

openQuestions.title: Verify tabpanel-through-::column on a real Chrome 154
openQuestions.detail: The spec assigns the tabpanel role to the ::column's originating element (the .pages scroller). Once Chrome 154 is available, dump the AX tree in tabs mode and record where tabpanel actually lands for column-fragmented content, since that clause has no other public test coverage in this repo.

summary: Advanced composition: multicol fragmentation feeding ::column-generated markers under the new tabs mode, with live re-fragmentation you can measure, honest capability banners, and a documented build-browser limitation on ::column counters.
